sentences.zh: 如果迟到了，他们就会挨打。

sentences.en: The children were only taken to see relatives if Fred and Rose went too.
sentences.zh: 只有在弗雷德和罗斯也去的情况下，孩子们才会被带去见亲戚。

sentences.en: Fred told his children,
sentences.zh: 弗雷德告诉他的孩子们：

sentences.en: We don't want to have anything to do with people outside.
sentences.zh: “我们不想和外面的人有任何瓜葛。”

sentences.en: We don't need them.
sentences.zh: “我们不需要他们。”

sentences.en: There are people out there who will hurt you.
sentences.zh: “外面有人会伤害你们。”

sentences.en: You're with people who will protect you.
sentences.zh: “你们和能保护你们的人在一起。”

sentences.en: One day at school, a teacher noticed a bruising on Anna-Marie's legs.
sentences.zh: 一天在学校，老师注意到安娜·玛丽腿上有淤青。

sentences.en: She asked Anna-Marie to roll down her socks and hitch up her skirt for a closer look.
sentences.zh: 她让安娜·玛丽放下袜子，撩起裙子以便仔细查看。

sentences.en: The teacher gasped in horror at the extent of the injuries.
sentences.zh: 老师看到伤势的严重程度，惊恐地倒吸一口凉气。

sentences.en: The teacher asked Anna-Marie, did you have an accident or did someone do it to you?
sentences.zh: 老师问安娜·玛丽：“你是出了意外，还是有人对你做了什么？”

sentences.en: Anna Marie desperately wanted to reveal that her stepmother had caused the injuries She opened her mouth in preparation for the truth But her fear of Rose was too great
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽拼命想说出是继母造成的伤害。她张开嘴准备说出真相，但她对罗斯的恐惧实在太深了。

sentences.en: Instead, Anna Marie lowered her head and said
sentences.zh: 相反，安娜·玛丽低下头说：

sentences.en: I fell over, miss I just fell over
sentences.zh: “我摔倒了，老师。我只是摔倒了。”

sentences.en: Privately, the teacher contacted the welfare department
sentences.zh: 私下里，老师联系了福利部门。

sentences.en: Later that day, a social worker arrived at 25 Cromwell Street to investigate the matter.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，一名社会工作者来到克伦威尔街25号调查此事。

sentences.en: Rose answered the door and was informed that there were concerns about Anna Marie.
sentences.zh: 罗斯开了门，被告知有人对安娜·玛丽的情况表示担忧。

sentences.en: Rose remained cool-headed and invited the social worker inside.
sentences.zh: 罗斯保持冷静，邀请社工进了屋。

sentences.en: She told the woman a story about Anna Marie falling down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 她向那名女子编造了一个关于安娜·玛丽从楼梯上摔下来的故事。

sentences.en: Anna Marie overheard the social worker reply,
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽听到社工回答道：

sentences.en: Oh, well, that's fine, Mrs WeSt. Then she left, never to return again.
sentences.zh: “哦，好吧，没问题，韦斯特太太。”然后她就离开了，再也没有回来。

sentences.en: Once she was gone, Anna Marie received one of the worst beatings of her life.
sentences.zh: 她走后，安娜·玛丽遭到了她一生中最严重的毒打之一。

sentences.en: All of the West children experienced abuse to some extent, but Anna Marie was singled out for the cruelest of treatment.
sentences.zh: 韦斯特家的所有孩子都在一定程度上遭受过虐待，但安娜·玛丽被单独挑出来，受到了最残忍的对待。

sentences.en: She explained that Rose inflicted pain with either a detached indifference or a calculated and controlled excitement.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，罗斯施加痛苦时，要么带着一种超然的冷漠，要么带着一种经过算计的、受控的兴奋。

sentences.en: Anna Marie suspected Rose resented her for being the only child in the household who wasn't biologically hers.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽怀疑罗斯怨恨她，因为她是家里唯一一个在生物学上不是她亲生的孩子。

sentences.en: There was a competitive element too, as Anna Marie was Fred's favourite.
sentences.zh: 这其中还有竞争的因素，因为安娜·玛丽是弗雷德的最爱。

sentences.en: In contrast to the sadistic, domineering and cruel way that Rose treated Anna Marie, Fred was affectionate.
sentences.zh: 与罗斯对待安娜·玛丽那种虐待狂般、专横且残忍的方式相比，弗雷德表现得很亲昵。

sentences.en: He'd force himself onto her, then say he loved her.
sentences.zh: 他会强迫她，然后说他爱她。

sentences.en: Anna Marie felt that her father saw her more as a girlfriend than a daughter.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽觉得父亲把她看作女朋友多过女儿。

sentences.en: Yet, Fred witnessed the abuse from Rose firsthand and never stepped in to defend Anna Marie.
sentences.zh: 然而，弗雷德亲眼目睹了罗斯的虐待，却从未出面保护过安娜·玛丽。

sentences.en: On the contrary, he chuckled at what his wife was doing
sentences.zh: 相反，他对自己妻子的所作所为暗自发笑。

sentences.en: Whenever Anna Marie told her father how Rose treated her, he'd reply
sentences.zh: 每当安娜·玛丽告诉父亲罗斯是如何对待她时，他总是回答：

sentences.en: Your mum is doing that because she loves you
sentences.zh: “你妈妈那样做是因为她爱你。”

sentences.en: It's for your own good
sentences.zh: “这是为了你好。”

sentences.en: Fred eventually developed a violent streak of his own
sentences.zh: 弗雷德最终也表现出了暴力倾向。

sentences.en: His eyes would roll to the back of his head and he'd start hitting, kicking and throttling Rose and his children all the while spitting out death threats
sentences.zh: 他会双眼翻白，开始殴打、踢踹并勒住罗斯和孩子们，同时口中喷出死亡威胁。

sentences.en: He once left Anna-Marie bloody after kicking her in the face with still-capped boots.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他穿着钢头靴踢安娜·玛丽的脸，把她踢得满脸是血。

sentences.en: Rose just laughed and said,
sentences.zh: 罗斯只是笑着说：

sentences.en: Serves you fucking right.
sentences.zh: “你活该，妈的。”

sentences.en: In the summer of 1979, Rose took 15-year-old Anna-Marie to see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 1979年夏天，罗斯带着15岁的安娜·玛丽去看医生。

sentences.en: Anna-Marie was visibly nervous and gave quiet answers to the doctor's personal questions.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽明显很紧张，对医生的私人问题回答得很小声。

sentences.en: The doctor then told her to lie on an examination table, where he began poking and prodding her stomach.
sentences.zh: 医生随后让她躺在检查台上，开始按压她的腹部。

sentences.en: His expression was stern as he engaged in a private conversation with Rose.
sentences.zh: 他表情严肃，与罗斯进行了私下交谈。

sentences.en: Anna Marie was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽怀孕了。

sentences.en: The pregnancy was ectopic, meaning the fertilised egg had implanted outside of the uterus.
sentences.zh: 这是宫外孕，意味着受精卵在子宫外着床了。

sentences.en: Ectopic pregnancies can't proceed normally, so Anna Marie was taken to hospital for a termination.
sentences.zh: 宫外孕无法正常发育，因此安娜·玛丽被送往医院进行终止妊娠手术。

sentences.en: Despite being underage, none of the hospital staff reported
sentences.zh: 尽管安娜·玛丽未成年，但没有一名医院工作人员向当局报告

sentences.en: Anna Marie's situation to authorities.
sentences.zh: 她的情况。

sentences.en: She suspected they viewed her as a, quote,
sentences.zh: 她怀疑他们把她看作是一个，引用一下，

sentences.en: 15-year-old slut who had got what she had been asking for and didn't deserve any sympathy.
sentences.zh: 15岁的荡妇，认为她那是自找的，根本不值得同情。

sentences.en: The truth was, the man who had impregnated Anna Marie was her own father, Fred WeSt.
sentences.zh: 事实是，让安娜·玛丽怀孕的男人正是她自己的父亲，弗雷德·韦斯特。

sentences.en: He had a saying that he'd repeat to his daughters.
sentences.zh: 他有一句经常对女儿们重复的话。

sentences.en: Your first baby should be your dad's.
sentences.zh: 你的第一个孩子应该是你爸爸的。

sentences.en: Days after the termination, Rose made Anna Marie perform housework, despite her still being in recovery and bearing stitches from her surgery.
sentences.zh: 终止妊娠后的几天里，罗斯强迫安娜·玛丽做家务，尽管她还在恢复期，手术缝合处还没拆线。

sentences.en: Anna Marie kept her head down like always, avoiding anything that might ignite Rose's wrath.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽像往常一样低着头，避免任何可能激怒罗斯的行为。

sentences.en: Yet, as she dusted, polished and vacuumed, she could sense tension rising.
sentences.zh: 然而，当她除尘、擦拭和吸尘时，她能感觉到紧张气氛在升级。

sentences.en: Anna-Marie explained.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽解释道。

sentences.en: Something had upset Rose.
sentences.zh: 有些事情惹恼了罗斯。

sentences.en: Nothing I did would be right.
sentences.zh: 我做什么都不对。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Rose's eyes filled with rage.
sentences.zh: 突然，罗斯的眼中充满了愤怒。

sentences.en: Behind them was the familiar, strange, dead look.
sentences.zh: 在那双眼睛背后，是那种熟悉的、奇怪的、死气沉沉的目光。

sentences.en: She pushed Anna-Marie to the floor and kicked her in the stomach, right in the stitches.
sentences.zh: 她把安娜·玛丽推倒在地，踢她的肚子，正好踢在伤口缝合处。

sentences.en: In immense pain, Anna-Marie fled to her room.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽忍着剧痛逃回了自己的房间。

sentences.en: When her father returned home later that day, he told her,
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，当她父亲回到家时，他对她说：

sentences.en: You shouldn't provoke and upset your mum like that.
sentences.zh: 你不应该那样去挑衅和惹你妈妈生气。

sentences.en: That night, Anna-Marie wept quietly into her pillow.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，安娜·玛丽对着枕头默默流泪。

sentences.en: She had reached her limit.
sentences.zh: 她已经忍无可忍了。

sentences.en: One night shortly after this, Anna-Marie put a long-considered plan into action.
sentences.zh: 此后不久的一个晚上，安娜·玛丽实施了一个酝酿已久的计划。

sentences.en: She took one last look at her sparsely furnished room, then grabbed a bag of belongings and made her way to the front door.
sentences.zh: 她最后看了一眼自己那陈设简陋的房间，然后抓起一个装有随身物品的包，走向前门。

sentences.en: Her bag hit a chair and the floor creaked in her haste, but Anna Marie managed to slip through the house without waking her parents.
sentences.zh: 由于匆忙，她的包撞到了椅子，地板也发出了吱呀声，但安娜·玛丽还是设法溜出了房子，没有惊醒她的父母。

sentences.en: She got past the locked gates and ran along Cromwell Street.
sentences.zh: 她穿过锁着的门，沿着克伦威尔街跑去。

sentences.en: She hadn't put much thought into what to do next.
sentences.zh: 她没怎么考虑接下来该怎么办。

sentences.en: She had little money, nowhere to go, and was terrified that her father would come looking for her.
sentences.zh: 她身上没多少钱，无处可去，而且非常害怕父亲会来找她。

sentences.en: She was also regretting leaving her siblings behind, none of whom knew about her plan to flee.
sentences.zh: 她也很后悔丢下了兄弟姐妹，他们中没有人知道她要逃跑的计划。

sentences.en: But Anna-Marie focused on the fact that she was free, telling herself, quote,
sentences.zh: 但安娜·玛丽专注于自己终于自由了这一事实，她对自己说，引用一下：

sentences.en: I would never go back.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会再回去。

sentences.en: No one could abuse me again.
sentences.zh: 再也没有人能虐待我了。

sentences.en: No matter what happened from now on, it couldn't be any worse than my life so far.
sentences.zh: 无论以后发生什么，都不可能比我目前的生活更糟糕了。

sentences.en: Anna Marie's harrowing statement added validity to the accusations that Fred and Rose West had a history of child sexual abuse and inceSt.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽令人揪心的陈述，为弗雷德和罗斯·韦斯特有长期虐待儿童和乱伦史的指控增加了可信度。

sentences.en: Rose was charged for causing or encouraging the commission of unlawful sexual intercourse with a minor and cruelty to a child.
sentences.zh: 罗斯被指控导致或怂恿他人与未成年人进行非法性行为以及虐待儿童。

sentences.en: She was granted bail under the condition that she not communicate with her younger children.
sentences.zh: 她获准保释，条件是不得与她年幼的孩子们联系。

sentences.en: The night she returned home, Rose was rushed to Gloucester
sentences.zh: 回到家的那天晚上，罗斯被紧急送往格洛斯特

sentences.en: Royal Hospital to have her stomach pumped.
sentences.zh: 皇家医院进行洗胃。

sentences.en: She had taken 48 painkiller pills, washed down with alcohol.
sentences.zh: 她服用了48片止痛药，并用酒精送服。

sentences.en: The underage West children, Tara, Louise, Barry, Rosemary Jr and Luciana were put under emergency protection orders.
sentences.zh: 韦斯特家未成年的孩子们——塔拉、路易丝、巴里、小罗斯玛丽和卢西亚娜——被置于紧急保护令之下。

sentences.en: Fred and Rose were forbidden from contacting them and weren't told where they were being held.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德和罗斯被禁止与他们联系，也不知道他们被安置在哪里。

sentences.en: The couple were eventually allowed to see their children, but only if the child themselves requested the meeting and a social worker was present.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇最终被允许见他们的孩子，但前提是孩子本人要求见面，并且有社会工作者在场。

sentences.en: Fred and Rose refused to see their children unless they could see them alone.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德和罗斯拒绝见他们的孩子，除非他们能单独见面。

sentences.en: In the lead-up to the couple's trial, Fred West was sent to a bail hostel in Birmingham, 60 miles north of
sentences.zh: 在两人受审前夕，弗雷德·韦斯特被送往伯明翰的一个保释旅舍，那里位于

sentences.en: Gloucester.
sentences.zh: 格洛斯特以北60英里处。

sentences.en: Rose visited him two or three times a week, sometimes with their older children May or Stephen.
sentences.zh: 罗斯每周去探望他两三次，有时带着他们的大孩子梅或斯蒂芬。

sentences.en: During visits, Fred and Rose wandered the grounds and had sex in view of passers-by and their own children.
sentences.zh: 探视期间，弗雷德和罗斯在场地里漫步，并在路人和他们自己的孩子面前发生性关系。

sentences.en: Rose wrote Fred a letter during his time away.
sentences.zh: 罗斯在弗雷德离开期间给他写了一封信。

sentences.en: It was adorned with their names and a drawing of a large love heart with an arrow through it.
sentences.zh: 信上装饰着他们的名字，还画着一颗被箭穿过的大爱心。

sentences.en: Remember I will always love you, she wrote, and everything will be alright.
sentences.zh: 记住我会永远爱你，她写道，一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: In custody, Fred's behaviour was described as exemplary.
sentences.zh: 在拘留期间，弗雷德的表现被描述为堪称典范。

sentences.en: He was consequently transferred to another bail hostel with even more relaxed conditions.
sentences.zh: 因此，他被转移到另一个条件更加宽松的保释旅舍。

sentences.en: Staff only checked on him every three days, which gave Fred time to go to Gloucester and back without anyone knowing he had gone.
sentences.zh: 工作人员每三天只检查他一次，这给了弗雷德时间往返格洛斯特，而没人知道他离开过。

sentences.en: The younger West children began sneaking out of their foster homes and meeting Fred at Gloucester
sentences.zh: 韦斯特家年幼的孩子们开始溜出寄养家庭，在格洛斯特

sentences.en: Park.
sentences.zh: 公园与弗雷德见面。

sentences.en: He eventually coaxed them back to Cromwell Street.
sentences.zh: 他最终诱骗他们回到了克伦威尔街。

sentences.en: Fred worked to convince his children that the authorities were wrong and evil.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德努力让孩子们相信当局是错误且邪恶的。

sentences.en: He warned them to keep their mouths shut, otherwise the police would take them away from those who loved and protected them.
sentences.zh: 他警告他们闭上嘴，否则警察会把他们从爱护和保护他们的人身边带走。

sentences.en: When Fred and Rose went to trial in early June 1993, the West children had been prepared to give evidence against them.
sentences.zh: 1993年6月初，当弗雷德和罗斯受审时，韦斯特家的孩子们本已准备好出庭作证指控他们。

sentences.en: But when asked if they were ready, the children all declined to proceed.
sentences.zh: 但当被问及是否准备好时，孩子们都拒绝继续。

sentences.en: It was a complicated case from the outset.
sentences.zh: 这从一开始就是一个复杂的案件。

sentences.en: The West daughter at the centre of the allegations denied that her father would ever do any of the things he was accused of.
sentences.zh: 作为指控核心的韦斯特家女儿否认她父亲会做出任何他被指控的事情。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Anna Marie West retracted the statement she'd made to Detective Constable Hazel Savage.
sentences.zh: 此外，安娜·玛丽·韦斯特撤回了她向黑兹尔·萨维奇警探所做的陈述。

sentences.en: Making the statement had brought up a lot of repressed trauma for Anna Marie and she was left shaken and anguished.
sentences.zh: 做出这份陈述勾起了安娜·玛丽许多被压抑的创伤，她感到震惊和痛苦。

sentences.en: She was still terrified of Rose and feared what would happen once Rose saw her statement.
sentences.zh: 她仍然害怕罗斯，担心罗斯看到她的陈述后会发生什么。

sentences.en: Anna Marie sought police protection, but they couldn't understand why she thought it was necessary.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽寻求警方保护，但他们无法理解她为什么认为有必要。

sentences.en: To Anna Marie, it felt like everyone thought she was making a fuss over nothing.
sentences.zh: 对安娜·玛丽来说，感觉每个人都认为她在小题大做。

sentences.en: She thought about Rose's temper, all those years of vicious beatings, abuse, and the men she was forced to have sex with.
sentences.zh: 她想到了罗斯的脾气，那些年遭受的恶毒殴打、虐待，以及她被迫与之发生性关系的男人们。

sentences.en: Wanting to forget it all, Anna Marie claimed the whole story was a figment of her imagination because she didn't like Fred or Rose.
sentences.zh: 为了忘记这一切，安娜·玛丽声称整个故事都是她想象出来的，因为她不喜欢弗雷德或罗斯。

sentences.en: When Constable Savage learned about this, she confronted Anna-Marie and said,
sentences.zh: 当萨维奇警官得知此事后，她与安娜·玛丽对质并说：

sentences.en: Tell me to my face this isn't true.
sentences.zh: 当面告诉我这不是真的。

sentences.en: Unable to meet the constable's gaze,
sentences.zh: 无法直视警官的目光，

sentences.en: Anna-Marie responded,
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽回答道：

sentences.en: It's not true.
sentences.zh: 这不是真的。

sentences.en: I made it all up.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是我编造的。

sentences.en: Constable Savage wasn't convinced.
sentences.zh: 萨维奇警官并不相信。

sentences.en: She warned Anna-Marie that she could be charged for wasting police time and making a false statement.
sentences.zh: 她警告安娜·玛丽，她可能会因浪费警力和做虚假陈述而被起诉。

sentences.en: But Anna-Marie remained steadfaSt.
sentences.zh: 但安娜·玛丽依然坚定。

sentences.en: With her younger siblings now safe from Fred and Rose in foster care,
sentences.zh: 随着她年幼的弟妹们现在在寄养家庭中远离了弗雷德和罗斯，

sentences.en: Anna Marie had the safety of her own children to think about.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽不得不考虑她自己孩子的安全。

sentences.en: The only piece of physical evidence that could help secure a conviction now was the videotape that allegedly contained footage of Fred raping his daughter.
sentences.zh: 现在唯一能帮助确保定罪的实物证据，就是那盘据称包含弗雷德强奸女儿录像的录像带。

sentences.en: Police had caused thousands of pounds worth of damage tearing 25 Cromwell Street apart trying to find it.
sentences.zh: 警方为了寻找它，拆毁了克伦威尔街25号，造成了数千英镑的损失。

sentences.en: It had been no easy feat, given that the inside of the property resembled a building site.
sentences.zh: 这绝非易事，因为房子的内部看起来就像个建筑工地。

sentences.en: Tools, wood, sand, cement, electrical cables, water mains, lino, copper pipes, carpet and paint tins were piled throughout.
sentences.zh: 工具、木材、沙子、水泥、电缆、水管、油毡、铜管、地毯和油漆罐堆得到处都是。

sentences.en: The police broke furniture, sifted through vacuum cleaner bags and searched behind skirting boards and under floorboards.
sentences.zh: 警察打碎了家具，翻遍了吸尘器袋，并在踢脚线后面和地板下进行了搜查。

sentences.en: They uncovered a large amount of sex paraphernalia, some of which was crudely handmade with scrap wood and metal.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了大量的性用具，其中一些是用废木头和金属粗糙手工制作的。

sentences.en: Police also uncovered a large collection of hardcore pornography magazines, sex toys, bondage gear, whips, chains, buckles, straps, and flails, as well as rubber suits and masks.
sentences.zh: 警方还发现了大量硬核色情杂志、性玩具、束缚装备、鞭子、锁链、扣环、皮带和连枷，以及橡胶服和面具。

sentences.en: There were dozens of photographs that Rose and Fred had taken of other people's genitals.
sentences.zh: 还有几十张罗斯和弗雷德拍摄的其他人私处的照片。

sentences.en: In total, police uncovered 99 pornographic videos, both homemade and commercial.
sentences.zh: 警方总共发现了99盘色情录像带，既有自制的，也有商业的。

sentences.en: The homemade footage was captured on 8mm film by Fred WeSt.
sentences.zh: 自制录像是由弗雷德·韦斯特用8毫米胶片拍摄的。

sentences.en: It depicted Rose performing explicit sexual acts with, quote, just about anything she could get her hands on, from domestic implements to fruit.
sentences.zh: 它描绘了罗斯与，引用一下，几乎任何她能弄到手的东西，从家用器具到水果，进行露骨的性行为。

sentences.en: The footage also captured Rose having sex with multiple people.
sentences.zh: 录像还捕捉到了罗斯与多人发生性关系。

sentences.en: Sometimes it was consensual amateur pornography, other times it was filmed via a peephole, as though in secret.
sentences.zh: 有时是自愿的业余色情片，有时则是通过窥视孔拍摄的，仿佛在秘密进行。

sentences.en: There was footage of Rose urinating on her bed, a sofa, and the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 录像中有罗斯在床上、沙发上和餐桌上小便的画面。

sentences.en: She was captured getting dressed in preparation to meet other men for sex, then later showing off her stained underwear.
sentences.zh: 她被拍到在准备与其他男人发生性关系时穿衣服，后来又炫耀她弄脏的内衣。

sentences.en: Fred also recorded himself performing gynecological examinations on his wife with many gratuitous close-ups.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德还录下了自己对他妻子进行妇科检查的过程，并有许多不必要的特写镜头。

sentences.en: But none of the videos contained the alleged child abuse.
sentences.zh: 但这些录像中没有一盘包含所谓的虐待儿童内容。

sentences.en: With no physical evidence or corroborating witnesses, the judge made the decision not to proceed with the trial.
sentences.zh: 由于没有实物证据或佐证证人，法官决定不再继续审判。

sentences.en: As a result, Fred and Rose West officially received a verdict of not guilty.
sentences.zh: 结果，弗雷德和罗斯·韦斯特正式获得了无罪判决。

sentences.en: The couple hugged each other in the dock, and for the second time in their marriage, they walked free from court together.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇在被告席上拥抱在一起，这是他们婚姻中第二次一起走出法庭，重获自由。

sentences.en: For Detective Constable Hazel Savage, the West case wasn't over.
sentences.zh: 对于黑兹尔·萨维奇警探来说，韦斯特案并没有结束。

sentences.en: During her investigations into the family, she had managed to track down each of Fred and Rose's older children, except for one.
sentences.zh: 在她对这个家庭的调查过程中，她设法追踪到了弗雷德和罗斯的每一个大孩子，除了一个。

sentences.en: All leads to locate the now 23-year-old Heather West had resulted in dead ends.
sentences.zh: 所有寻找现年23岁的希瑟·韦斯特的线索都陷入了死胡同。

sentences.en: One of the last confirmed sightings of Heather occurred on Wednesday June 17, 1987, when she was four months shy of turning 17.
sentences.zh: 最后一次确认看到希瑟是在1987年6月17日星期三，当时她离17岁生日还有四个月。

sentences.en: Witnesses recalled the exact date as it was the day that Anna-Marie West had hosted a birthday party for her three-year-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 目击者记得确切的日期，因为那天是安娜·玛丽·韦斯特为她三岁的女儿举办生日派对的日子。

sentences.en: The party was held at Anna-Marie's home in the White City
sentences.zh: 派对是在安娜·玛丽位于白城

sentences.en: Estate.
sentences.zh: 庄园的家中举行的。

sentences.en: It had been a pleasant summer day and the house was abuzz with children.
sentences.zh: 那是一个愉快的夏日，房子里挤满了孩子。

sentences.en: Anna-Marie was surprised when her typically antisocial father and stepmother showed up.
sentences.zh: 当她那通常反社会的父亲和继母出现时，安娜·玛丽感到很惊讶。

sentences.en: She was even more shocked to see that they'd brought all the younger West children with them, as family outings were incredibly rare.
sentences.zh: 看到他们把韦斯特家所有年幼的孩子都带来了，她更加震惊，因为家庭出游极其罕见。

sentences.en: Heather West had always been quiet, but partygoers noticed she was particularly distant that day.
sentences.zh: 希瑟·韦斯特一直很安静，但参加派对的人注意到她那天特别疏远。

sentences.en: She spent most of the afternoon alone in the back garden, looking sad and lethargic.
sentences.zh: 她大部分下午都独自待在后花园里，看起来既悲伤又无精打采。

sentences.en: If anyone approached her, Fred or Rose would be by her side in an instant.
sentences.zh: 如果有人接近她，弗雷德或罗斯会立刻出现在她身边。

sentences.en: Rose explained to the other guests that there had been problems with Heather before they left for the party.
sentences.zh: 罗斯向其他客人解释说，在他们出发去派对之前，希瑟就出过问题。

sentences.en: Fred bullied Heather throughout the event, saying, don't fucking stand there like a lemon, a derogatory word he used for lesbian.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德在整个活动中欺负希瑟，说，别他妈像个柠檬一样站在那儿，这是他用来指代女同性恋的贬义词。

sentences.en: Heather retorted angrily, why don't you just fuck off and leave me a fucking loan?
sentences.zh: 希瑟愤怒地反驳道，你为什么不滚开，让我一个人待着？

sentences.en: Anna Marie tried to find out what was going on, but Heather was tight-lipped.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽试图弄清楚发生了什么，但希瑟守口如瓶。

sentences.en: She actively avoided being in any photos or videos taken during the day.
sentences.zh: 她积极避免出现在当天拍摄的任何照片或视频中。

sentences.en: One photo captured her in the garden as she was mid-turn, trying to avoid the camera.
sentences.zh: 一张照片捕捉到了她在花园里转身的一瞬间，试图避开镜头。

sentences.en: Standing nearby was Fred, with a big smile.
sentences.zh: 站在附近的是弗雷德，脸上带着灿烂的笑容。

sentences.en: At the time, Heather was making arrangements to move to Torquay, a seaside town 130 miles from Gloucester.
sentences.zh: 当时，希瑟正在安排搬到托基，这是一个距离格洛斯特130英里的海滨小镇。

sentences.en: She had applied for a job as a cleaner for a holiday camp there.
sentences.zh: 她申请了那里一个度假营地的清洁工工作。

sentences.en: The prospect excited her.
sentences.zh: 这个前景让她感到兴奋。

sentences.en: Then, the night after Anna Marie's daughter's birthday party, Heather received a phone call.
sentences.zh: 然后，在安娜·玛丽女儿生日派对后的第二天晚上，希瑟接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: The woman on the other line apologised, saying that Heather's job application hadn't been successful.
sentences.zh: 电话那头的女人道歉说，希瑟的工作申请没有成功。

sentences.en: Heather was devastated.
sentences.zh: 希瑟崩溃了。

sentences.en: She kept her siblings up all night with her sobbing
sentences.zh: 她整晚都在啜泣，让她的兄弟姐妹们无法入睡。

sentences.en: The following day of Friday June 19, the West children returned home from school to find that Heather wasn't there
sentences.zh: 第二天，6月19日星期五，韦斯特家的孩子们放学回家，发现希瑟不在那里。

sentences.en: Fred and Rose explained that Heather had received some good news
sentences.zh: 弗雷德和罗斯解释说，希瑟收到了一些好消息。

sentences.en: Their job in Torquay was back on
sentences.zh: 她在托基的工作又有着落了。

sentences.en: She'd packed a bag and got a lift with a friend, leaving 25 Cromwell Street for good
sentences.zh: 她收拾好行李，搭朋友的车走了，永远离开了克伦威尔街25号。

sentences.en: Fred was calm as he spoke about Heather's abrupt departure.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德在谈到希瑟的突然离开时表现得很平静。

sentences.en: Then he approached his son Stephen and asked for help digging a hole in the back garden.
sentences.zh: 然后他走近他的儿子斯蒂芬，请求帮忙在后花园挖个坑。

sentences.en: Fred explained he wanted to install a fish pond.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德解释说他想建一个鱼塘。

sentences.en: Stephen did as he was told, but a couple of days later, he noticed that the hole had been filled in.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬照做了，但几天后，他注意到那个坑已经被填上了。

sentences.en: No one heard from Heather West again.
sentences.zh: 再也没有人听到过希瑟·韦斯特的消息。

sentences.en: Over the years, Fred and Rose gave conflicting stories as to her whereabouts
sentences.zh: 多年来，弗雷德和罗斯对她的下落给出了相互矛盾的说法。

sentences.en: To some, they said that Heather had run away or left to start a new job
sentences.zh: 对一些人，他们说希瑟离家出走了，或者去开始一份新工作了。

sentences.en: They told others that she'd become a drug dealer, was involved in credit card fraud, or had fallen in with the wrong crowd
sentences.zh: 他们告诉其他人，她成了毒贩，参与了信用卡欺诈，或者结交了坏朋友。

sentences.en: Rose mentioned having a, quote, hell of a row with Heather before she left over Heather being a lesbian
sentences.zh: 罗斯提到在希瑟离开前，因为她是女同性恋，两人大吵了一架，引用一下，简直是地狱般的争吵。

sentences.en: The couple constantly provoked Heather about being gay, even though there was no indication that she was, and Rose herself had numerous affairs with women.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇不断挑衅希瑟是同性恋，尽管没有任何迹象表明她是，而且罗斯本人也曾多次与女性有染。

sentences.en: It didn't matter anyway, as Fred later told others that Heather had run off with a boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这都不重要，因为弗雷德后来告诉别人，希瑟是跟男朋友私奔了。

sentences.en: At one stage, Anna Marie West travelled to Torquay in search of Heather, but no one she spoke to had ever seen or heard of her half-sister.
sentences.zh: 有一次，安娜·玛丽·韦斯特前往托基寻找希瑟，但她交谈过的任何人都从未见过或听说过她这个同父异母的妹妹。

sentences.en: Stephen and Mae West also made various attempts to locate Heather, including reaching out to television shows that specialised in finding missing people.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和梅·韦斯特也曾多次尝试寻找希瑟，包括联系专门寻找失踪人口的电视节目。

sentences.en: At one stage, the siblings told Fred they were going to report Heather missing.
sentences.zh: 有一次，兄妹俩告诉弗雷德他们要报警说希瑟失踪了。

sentences.en: Fred talked them out of it.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德劝阻了他们。

sentences.en: He said that Heather was involved in some illegal business and if they alerted police, they'd be snitching.
sentences.zh: 他说希瑟卷入了一些非法生意，如果他们报警，他们就是在告密。

sentences.en: Rose said that if Heather wanted to contact them, she would
sentences.zh: 罗斯说，如果希瑟想联系他们，她会联系的。

sentences.en: Every so often, Fred claimed to have both seen and spoken to Heather
sentences.zh: 每隔一段时间，弗雷德就声称自己既见过希瑟，也和她说过话。

sentences.en: At one stage, he said she was working for a community centre in Gloucester
sentences.zh: 有一次，他说她在格洛斯特的一家社区中心工作。

sentences.en: Anna Marie looked into this claim, but to no result
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽调查了这一说法，但一无所获。

sentences.en: Fred conceded that Heather must have quit and moved on
sentences.zh: 弗雷德承认希瑟一定是辞职离开了。

sentences.en: Whenever Fred told any story pertaining to seeing Heather, Rose would warn him to shut up.
sentences.zh: 每当弗雷德讲起关于见到希瑟的故事时，罗斯都会警告他闭嘴。

sentences.en: Whatever the explanation, Fred and Rose were adamant that Heather was fine.
sentences.zh: 无论解释是什么，弗雷德和罗斯都坚称希瑟很好。

sentences.en: They told others that they'd filed a missing person report, but this wasn't true.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉别人说已经报了失踪人口，但这并不是真的。

sentences.en: Fred would say,
sentences.zh: 弗雷德会说：

sentences.en: Heather's left us, she's disappeared, and that's it.
sentences.zh: 希瑟离开我们了，她失踪了，就是这样。

sentences.en: Closed.
sentences.zh: 结束了。

sentences.en: I don't want to hear any more about it.
sentences.zh: 我不想再听到关于这件事的任何消息。

sentences.en: We won't mention it again.
sentences.zh: 我们不会再提它了。

sentences.en: I don't want you coming round in future if you do mention Heather."
sentences.zh: 如果你再提希瑟，以后就别再上门了。

sentences.en: Prior to Heather's disappearance, a male guest was spending the night at 25 Cromwell Street.
sentences.zh: 在希瑟失踪前，一位男性客人曾在克伦威尔街25号过夜。

sentences.en: In the early hours of the morning, he woke up to the sound of something rustling around the house.
sentences.zh: 凌晨时分，他被屋子里某种沙沙作响的声音吵醒了。

sentences.en: A young woman cried out, no, no, please.
sentences.zh: 一个年轻女孩喊道：不，不，求求你。

sentences.en: This continued on and off for the next 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在接下来的20分钟里断断续续地持续着。

sentences.en: In the morning, Rose West informed the man that it was her daughter Heather who suffered from nightmares.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，罗斯·韦斯特告诉那个男人，是她的女儿希瑟患有噩梦症。

sentences.en: The man had noticed that Heather seemed a bit shy and down in the dumps the night before.
sentences.zh: 那个男人注意到，前一天晚上希瑟看起来有点害羞且情绪低落。

sentences.en: Rose explained that Heather was just, quote, backwards and didn't talk much.
sentences.zh: 罗斯解释说，希瑟只是“落后”，不太爱说话。

sentences.en: On a separate occasion, a female lodger at 25 Cromwell Street heard screams coming from the cellar.
sentences.zh: 另有一次，克伦威尔街25号的一位女性房客听到地窖里传来了尖叫声。

sentences.en: A girl helplessly shouted,
sentences.zh: 一个女孩无助地喊道：

sentences.en: Stop it, Daddy.
sentences.zh: 别这样，爸爸。

sentences.en: The lodger didn't investigate or report the matter, but she believed the voice might have been Heather West's.
sentences.zh: 那位房客没有去调查或报告此事，但她相信那个声音可能是希瑟·韦斯特的。

sentences.en: Other visitors recalled that Heather would stand in the corner of a room or in the doorway, warily watching her father.
sentences.zh: 其他访客回忆说，希瑟总是站在房间角落或门口，警惕地盯着她父亲。

sentences.en: She bit her fingernails until they bled and rocked herself back and forth for hours, unable to sit still.
sentences.zh: 她咬指甲咬到流血，还不停地前后摇晃身体，一坐就是几个小时，无法安静下来。

sentences.en: Heather had a very close friend at school called Denise Harrison.
sentences.zh: 希瑟在学校有一个非常亲密的朋友，名叫丹妮丝·哈里森。

sentences.en: Shortly before Heather went missing, Denise noticed Heather was more morose than usual.
sentences.zh: 在希瑟失踪前不久，丹妮丝注意到她比平时更加忧郁。

sentences.en: One day, Denise was walking near Cromwell Street when she spotted an upset-looking Heather sitting on a wall.
sentences.zh: 有一天，丹妮丝走在克伦威尔街附近时，看到希瑟坐在墙头上，看起来很难过。

sentences.en: Denise asked what was wrong and Heather started to cry.
sentences.zh: 丹妮丝问她怎么了，希瑟开始哭泣。

sentences.en: Heather confided in Denise that she had been sexually abused.
sentences.zh: 希瑟向丹妮丝吐露，她遭到了性虐待。

sentences.en: Her father would come into her room at night and force himself on her.
sentences.zh: 她父亲会在晚上进入她的房间，强迫她发生关系。

sentences.en: He also beat her.
sentences.zh: 他还殴打她。

sentences.en: Denise asked, haven't you told your mum?
sentences.zh: 丹妮丝问：你没告诉过你妈妈吗？

sentences.en: Heather explained that Rose refused to do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 希瑟解释说，罗斯拒绝为此做任何事。

sentences.en: Rose thought Heather was a, quote, little bitch who deserved the beatings.
sentences.zh: 罗斯认为希瑟是个“小贱人”，活该被打。

sentences.en: Heather said she hadn't told anyone else because she was too frightened.
sentences.zh: 希瑟说她没告诉过别人，因为她太害怕了。

sentences.en: Denise didn't doubt Heather for a second.
sentences.zh: 丹妮丝一点也不怀疑希瑟。

sentences.en: Heather refused to shower at school and wore long-sleeved blouses with her socks pulled up to her knees.
sentences.zh: 希瑟拒绝在学校洗澡，总是穿着长袖衬衫，袜子拉到膝盖处。

sentences.en: But Denise had once caught a glimpse of Heather's bare arms and legs.
sentences.zh: 但丹妮丝曾瞥见希瑟裸露的手臂和腿。

sentences.en: They were covered in severe bruising.
sentences.zh: 上面布满了严重的淤青。

sentences.en: Denise's mother knew Fred West, and when Denise told her about Heather's secret, her mother refused to believe that Fred was capable of such horrible things.
sentences.zh: 丹妮丝的母亲认识弗雷德·韦斯特，当丹妮丝告诉她希瑟的秘密时，她母亲拒绝相信弗雷德会做出如此可怕的事情。

sentences.en: Three weeks later, Heather finished her last term of school.
sentences.zh: 三周后，希瑟结束了最后一个学期的学业。

sentences.en: Denise Harrison never heard from her again.
sentences.zh: 丹妮丝·哈里森再也没有收到过她的消息。

sentences.en: By 1992, Heather West had been missing for five years.
sentences.zh: 到1992年，希瑟·韦斯特已经失踪五年了。

sentences.en: Detective Constable Hazel Savage believed that Heather could provide further insight into the allegations that Fred and Rose West abused their children.
sentences.zh: 侦探警员黑兹尔·萨维奇认为，希瑟或许能为弗雷德和罗斯·韦斯特虐待子女的指控提供进一步的线索。

sentences.en: She worked diligently to track Heather down, but by the time Fred and Rose faced trial the following year, Constable Savage had failed to find a single trace of her.
sentences.zh: 她努力寻找希瑟的下落，但到次年弗雷德和罗斯受审时，萨维奇警员仍未找到她的一丝踪迹。

sentences.en: But her suspicions were growing.
sentences.zh: 但她的怀疑越来越深。

sentences.en: She had been informed of a West family joke that the younger children had repeated to their foster parents.
sentences.zh: 她被告知韦斯特家有一个笑话，年幼的孩子们曾向他们的寄养父母提起过。

sentences.en: Whenever they were naughty, their father would tell them to behave or, quote, end up under the patio like Heather.

sentences.en: Thursday, February 24, 1994, marked almost a year after Fred and Rose West's not guilty verdict.
sentences.zh: 1994年2月24日星期四，距离弗雷德和罗斯·韦斯特被判无罪几乎过去了一年。

sentences.zh: 那天早上，

sentences.en: 40-year-old Rose West answered the door She was informed that an inquiry had been launched into the disappearance of Heather West and was handed a search warrant
sentences.zh: 40岁的罗斯·韦斯特开了门。她被告知警方已对希瑟·韦斯特的失踪展开调查，并被递交了搜查令。

sentences.en: Rose immediately started screaming profanities and calling the officers offensive names At that moment, Stephen West arrived home He read the warrant
sentences.zh: 罗斯立刻开始大声咒骂，用侮辱性的词汇称呼警官。就在这时，斯蒂芬·韦斯特回到了家。他读了搜查令。

sentences.en: It specified that the police's purpose was to dig up the back garden to search for the body of Heather West
sentences.zh: 搜查令明确指出，警方的目的是挖掘后花园，寻找希瑟·韦斯特的尸体。

sentences.en: Stephen asked the officers to wait until his father returned home They told him there was no time
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬要求警官等他父亲回来。他们告诉他没时间了。

sentences.en: The officers marched into the house armed with tools and spades
sentences.zh: 警官们带着工具和铁锹冲进了屋子。

sentences.en: Stephen called his father on his mobile phone and informed him what was going on
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬用手机给父亲打了电话，告知了发生的一切。

sentences.en: 52-year-old Fred West was at a job site only 30 minutes away, but it was almost three and a half hours before he arrived home.
sentences.zh: 52岁的弗雷德·韦斯特当时正在仅30分钟路程外的工地上，但他花了近三个半小时才回到家。

sentences.en: He never explained why it took him so long.
sentences.zh: 他从未解释为什么花了这么长时间。

sentences.en: At home, Fred maintained his composure while Rose wept.
sentences.zh: 在家中，弗雷德保持镇定，而罗斯则在哭泣。

sentences.en: The couple spoke quietly in the kitchen before retreating upstairs to talk in private.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇在厨房里低声交谈，随后退到楼上私下谈话。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Fred went to Gloucester Central Police Station.
sentences.zh: 不久后，弗雷德去了格洛斯特中央警察局。

sentences.en: Rose remained at home to take part in a recorded interview.
sentences.zh: 罗斯留在家里参加录音采访。

sentences.en: She was belligerent throughout, giving short, sharp and evasive answers.
sentences.zh: 她全程表现得好斗，回答简短、尖锐且闪烁其词。

sentences.en: She said she couldn't remember much about the circumstances of Heather's disappearance, telling the interviewing officer,
sentences.zh: 她说她记不清希瑟失踪时的具体情况了，并对采访警官说：

sentences.en: If you had any brains at all, you could find her.
sentences.zh: 如果你还有点脑子，就能找到她。

sentences.en: It can't be that bloody difficult.
sentences.zh: 这事儿没那么难吧。

sentences.en: When asked if she used to punish Heather when she misbehaved, Rose explained,
sentences.zh: 当被问及她是否会在希瑟不听话时惩罚她时，罗斯解释道：

sentences.en: I just sent her to bed.
sentences.zh: 我只是让她上床睡觉。

sentences.en: As for whether she thought Heather was alive, Rose replied,
sentences.zh: 至于她是否认为希瑟还活着，罗斯回答：

sentences.en: Well, why not?
sentences.zh: 嗯，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Unless something horrible has happened to her.
sentences.zh: 除非她发生了什么可怕的事情。

sentences.en: The police informed Rose they were aware of the family joke about Heather being buried under the patio in the rear garden of 25 Cromwell Street
sentences.zh: 警方告知罗斯，他们知道关于希瑟被埋在克伦威尔街25号后花园露台下的那个家庭笑话。

sentences.en: Consequently, they were going to dig up the entire area to look for her
sentences.zh: 因此，他们打算挖掘整个区域来寻找她。

sentences.en: Rose responded
sentences.zh: 罗斯回应道：

sentences.en: There's nothing you will stop at, is there?
sentences.zh: 你们真是无所不用其极，是吧？

sentences.en: Look, the house is yours, have it
sentences.zh: 听着，房子是你们的，拿去吧。

sentences.en: Do what you are going to do
sentences.zh: 想干什么就干什么吧。

sentences.en: At Gloucester Central Police Station, Fred West voluntarily participated in an interview with Detective Constable Hazel Savage
sentences.zh: 在格洛斯特中央警察局，弗雷德·韦斯特自愿参加了与黑兹尔·萨维奇警探的谈话。

sentences.en: Given the situation, he seemed unusually calm and affable
sentences.zh: 鉴于当时的情况，他显得异常冷静且和蔼可亲。

sentences.en: Unprompted, he announced that he had not murdered his daughter
sentences.zh: 他主动声称自己没有谋杀女儿。

sentences.en: Fred claimed that Heather was alive and that he'd recently seen her in Birmingham, a city 60 miles northeast of Gloucester
sentences.zh: 弗雷德声称希瑟还活着，他最近在伯明翰见过她，那是一座位于格洛斯特东北60英里的城市。

sentences.en: He said her hair was expensively styled and she looked more ladylike.
sentences.zh: 他说她的发型很昂贵，看起来更有淑女风范了。

sentences.en: Fred claimed that he and Heather were very close and that any of his family members would attest to that.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德声称他和希瑟关系非常亲密，任何家人都可以证明这一点。

sentences.en: But for reasons he didn't understand, Heather had something against Rose and was prone to insulting her.
sentences.zh: 但出于他不理解的原因，希瑟对罗斯有意见，还经常侮辱她。

sentences.en: Fred maintained that neither he nor Rose reported Heather missing because they didn't want to get her in trouble.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德坚持说，他和罗斯都没有报失踪，因为他们不想让希瑟惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: He implied that Heather was involved in illegal sex work and changed her name frequently as a result.
sentences.zh: 他暗示希瑟从事非法性工作，因此经常改名换姓。

sentences.en: Constable Savage asked outright,
sentences.zh: 萨维奇警探直截了当地问：

sentences.en: Where is Heather, Fred?
sentences.zh: 希瑟在哪儿，弗雷德？

sentences.en: Fred replied,
sentences.zh: 弗雷德回答：

sentences.en: You find her and I'll be happy.
sentences.zh: 你找到她，我会很高兴的。

sentences.en: That's all I can say.
sentences.zh: 我只能说这些。

sentences.en: The garden at the rear of 25 Cromwell Street was less than 30 feet long and 20 feet wide.
sentences.zh: 克伦威尔街25号的后花园长不到30英尺，宽不到20英尺。

sentences.en: Fred had done extensive renovations that impacted the space over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，弗雷德进行了大规模的翻修，影响了这片空间。

sentences.en: Neighbours had heard him banging, scraping and digging long into the night, earning him a reputation as the man who couldn't stop working.
sentences.zh: 邻居们曾听到他深夜还在敲敲打打、刮擦挖掘，这让他赢得了“干活狂人”的称号。

sentences.en: He had demolished a garage and replaced it with a ground floor extension that consisted of more rooms and a new kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他拆掉了一个车库，取而代之的是一个地面扩建部分，包括更多的房间和一个新厨房。

sentences.en: In the back garden, he tore out the fruit trees and chicken coop, leaving just a row of tall, thin, leyland pine trees that blocked his neighbour's view.
sentences.zh: 在后花园里，他拔掉了果树和鸡舍，只留下一排高大细长的利兰柏树，挡住了邻居的视线。

sentences.en: He then completely paved over the garden with heavy stone slabs to form a patio.
sentences.zh: 然后，他用厚重的石板完全铺平了花园，做成了一个露台。

sentences.en: Searching the small area required great effort and coSt. Just as the sun began to set, it started to rain.
sentences.zh: 搜查这片小区域需要付出巨大的努力和成本。就在太阳落山时，开始下雨了。

sentences.en: The search was called off until the following morning, with a uniformed constable standing guard in the patio overnight.
sentences.zh: 搜查工作暂停至次日清晨，一名穿制服的警员整夜在露台上守卫。

sentences.en: That night, Fred and Rose went for a walk in a nearby park, which was completely out of character.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，弗雷德和罗斯去附近的公园散步，这完全不符合他们的性格。

sentences.en: When they returned, Fred showered and sat down to watch the news.
sentences.zh: 回来后，弗雷德洗了个澡，坐下来看新闻。

sentences.en: It was the only thing he ever watched on television, never missing the 1, 6, 9, 10 o'clock or midnight broadcasts.
sentences.zh: 这是他电视上唯一看的东西，从不错过1点、6点、9点、10点或午夜的广播。

sentences.en: His need to watch it and know what was happening bordered on obsession.
sentences.zh: 他需要观看新闻并了解时事的欲望近乎痴迷。

sentences.en: The following day, a small excavator and mechanical digger were brought to 25 Cromwell
sentences.zh: 第二天，一台小型挖掘机和机械挖土机被带到了克伦威尔街25号。

sentences.zh: 107: 一队穿着工作服的15名男子挤进狭小的露台，开始用机器和手工挖掘。

sentences.en: A team of 15 men in boiler suits crammed into the small patio and started digging by machine and hand.
sentences.zh: 108: 下午时分，雨断断续续地飘着，一个小棚子和一个自制烧烤架被拆除了。

sentences.en: Rain drizzled on and off throughout the afternoon as a small shed and a homemade barbecue were dismantled.
sentences.zh: 109: 石板被掀起并堆在一边。

sentences.en: The stone slabs were then lifted up and stacked to one side.
sentences.zh: 110: 石板下面是一层坚硬的地面和碎石。

sentences.en: Under the slabs was a crusty layer of solid ground and gravel.
sentences.zh: 111: 大约一英尺深处是散发着污水恶臭的深色厚泥。

sentences.en: About a foot down was thick, dark mud that reeked of sewage.
sentences.zh: 112: 淤泥下面是致密、不透水的灰色粘土。

sentences.en: Underneath the sludge was dense, impervious grey clay.
sentences.zh: 113: 警官们挖到六英尺深处时有了发现。

sentences.en: Officers dug six feet down and made a discovery.
sentences.zh: 114: 一些小骨头和骨头碎片。

sentences.en: Small bones and bone fragments.
sentences.zh: 115: 很快得出结论，它们来自死去的动物。

sentences.en: It was quickly concluded that they were from dead animals.
sentences.zh: 116: 挖得越深，泥土就变得越稀。

sentences.en: The further they dug, the more liquefied the mud became.
sentences.zh: 117: 找来了一台泵，但淤泥刚被抽走，更多的泥浆就渗回来淹没了坑洞。

sentences.en: A pump was brought in, but as soon as the sludge was pumped out, more seeped back in and flooded the hole.
sentences.zh: 118: 坑洞越大，液体散发的臭味就越难闻。

sentences.en: The larger the hole became, the worse the liquid smelt.
sentences.zh: 119: 它呈现出一种稀薄的蛋奶糊状。

sentences.en: It developed a thin, custard-like consistency.
sentences.zh: 120: 一名站在挖掘现场边缘木板上的侦探辨认出了那股无法错认的气味。

sentences.en: A detective standing on a wooden plank that framed the edge of the dig site identified the unmistakable odor.
sentences.zh: 121: 那是腐烂的恶臭。

sentences.en: It was the stench of decomposition.
sentences.zh: 122: 罗斯·韦斯特对警方的挖掘工作感到越来越不安。

sentences.en: Rose West was becoming increasingly rattled by the police work.
sentences.zh: 123: 弗雷德安顿好楼上的她，然后走向黑兹尔·萨维奇警探。

sentences.en: Fred settled her upstairs and then approached Detective Constable Hazel Savage.
sentences.zh: 124: “我们可以去警察局吗？”他问道。一上警车，弗雷德就说：

sentences.en: can we go to the police station he asked as soon as he was in the police car fred said
sentences.zh: 125: “我杀了她。”这一切发生在1987年6月19日星期五。

sentences.en: i killed her it had all happened on friday june 19 1987

sentences.en: heather west was 16 years old and had just found out that the job in torquay had fallen through
sentences.zh: 127: 考虑到她离开家的渴望，希瑟深受打击。

sentences.en: Given her eagerness to leave home, Heather was crushed.
sentences.zh: 128: 弗雷德说他们谈了大半夜，之后希瑟哭着回房睡觉了。

sentences.en: Fred said they'd talked it over for most of the night before Heather retired to bed in tears.
sentences.zh: 129: 第二天早上，罗斯告诉弗雷德：

Let her go.

sentences.en: Fred replied,
sentences.zh: 133: “好吧，别急着回来。”

sentences.en: All right then, don't hurry back.
sentences.zh: 134: “给我个机会和希瑟谈谈。”

sentences.en: Give me a chance to talk to Heather.
sentences.zh: 135: 他希望自己能说服她留下来。

sentences.en: He hoped he could persuade her to stay.
sentences.zh: 136: 罗斯出门去商店了。

sentences.en: Rose left for the shops.
sentences.zh: 137: 韦斯特家年幼的孩子们已经在学校了。

sentences.en: The younger West children were already at school.
sentences.zh: 138: 希瑟的学期刚刚结束。

sentences.en: Heather's school term had just finished.
sentences.zh: 139: 她收拾好行李，放在了前门边。

sentences.en: She had packed her bags and left them by the front door.
sentences.zh: 140: 弗雷德叫了她一声。

sentences.en: Fred called out to her.
sentences.zh: 141: 希瑟出现了，双手插在口袋里，看起来一脸得意。

sentences.en: Heather appeared looking smug with her hands tucked in her pockets.
sentences.zh: 142: 弗雷德问：“你离家出走是怎么回事？”

sentences.en: Fred asked, what's this about you leaving home?
sentences.zh: 143: 他告诉希瑟她还太小，而且身为女同性恋会染上艾滋病。

sentences.en: He told Heather she was too young and that being a lesbian meant she would catch AIDS.
sentences.zh: 144: 他告诉希瑟：“我不会让你走的。”

sentences.en: He told Heather, I'm not going to let you go.
sentences.zh: 145: 她傲慢地回应道。

sentences.en: She responded arrogantly.
sentences.zh: 146: “如果你他妈的不让我走，我就给孩子们下药，让他们都从教堂屋顶跳下去，摔死在地上。”

sentences.en: If you don't fucking let me go, I'll give all the kids acid and they'll all jump off the church roof and be dead on the floor.
sentences.zh: 147: 弗雷德大发雷霆。

sentences.en: Fred lost his temper.
sentences.zh: 148: 他想扇希瑟的脸，但很快停住了。

sentences.en: He went to slap Heather's face, but quickly stopped himself.
sentences.zh: 149: 他曾有一次在争吵中扇了罗斯一巴掌，结果导致她下巴脱臼。

sentences.en: He had once slapped Rose during an argument and subsequently dislocated her jaw.
sentences.zh: 149: 他曾有一次在争吵中扇了罗斯一巴掌，结果导致她下巴脱臼。

sentences.en: Instead, he grabbed Heather by the throat and tightened his grip.
sentences.zh: 相反，他抓住希瑟的喉咙，用力掐紧。

sentences.en: I just wanted to shake her, Fred told Detective Constable Hazel Savage.
sentences.zh: 我只是想摇晃她，弗雷德告诉警探黑兹尔·萨维奇。

sentences.en: I wanted to take that smirk off her face.
sentences.zh: 我想抹掉她脸上那种假笑。

sentences.en: As Fred throttled Heather, she began turning blue.
sentences.zh: 当弗雷德掐住希瑟时，她的脸色开始发青。

sentences.en: He quickly let her go.
sentences.zh: 他很快松开了手。

sentences.en: She fell back against the washing machine, then slid down to the floor.
sentences.zh: 她向后倒在洗衣机上，然后滑落到地板上。

sentences.en: When Fred realised that Heather was no longer breathing, he tried to perform mouth-to-mouth resuscitation and chest compressions.
sentences.zh: 当弗雷德意识到希瑟已经停止呼吸时，他尝试进行口对口人工呼吸和胸外按压。

sentences.en: But he'd only ever seen it performed on television and didn't actually know what to do.
sentences.zh: 但他以前只在电视上见过别人这样做，实际上并不知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: Heather's body turned cold and Fred noticed she had wet herself.
sentences.zh: 希瑟的身体变冷了，弗雷德注意到她失禁了。

sentences.en: He thought to himself, what the hell's gone wrong?
sentences.zh: 他心想，到底出了什么问题？

sentences.en: I never intended this.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过会这样。

sentences.en: He dragged Heather to the bathroom, stripped her naked and placed her into the tub.
sentences.zh: 他把希瑟拖到浴室，剥光她的衣服，把她放进浴缸里。

sentences.en: He then doused her in cold water in an attempt to rouse her.
sentences.zh: 然后他用冷水泼她，试图唤醒她。

sentences.en: Fred West recalled,
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·韦斯特回忆道，

sentences.en: I can remember standing there and thinking, how do you know when someone's dead?
sentences.zh: 我记得当时站在那里想，你怎么知道一个人什么时候死了？

sentences.en: He took Heather's body out of the tub and dried it off.
sentences.zh: 他把希瑟的尸体从浴缸里拿出来擦干。

sentences.en: He intended to dismember her but didn't want her to, quote, suddenly come alive during the process.
sentences.zh: 他打算肢解她，但不想让她，引用他的话，在过程中突然活过来。

sentences.en: So he tied a pair of tights around her neck.
sentences.zh: 所以他用一条连裤袜绑在她的脖子上。

sentences.en: He also closed her eyes, as he didn't want her looking up at him while he worked.
sentences.zh: 他还闭上了她的眼睛，因为他不想在她工作时被她盯着看。

sentences.en: Fred then cut Heather's neck with a serrated saw used for cutting ice blocks and frozen meat.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德随后用一把锯冰块和冷冻肉的锯齿锯割开了希瑟的脖子。

sentences.en: He twisted off Heather's head.
sentences.zh: 他扭下了希瑟的头。

sentences.en: He did the same thing to remove her legs.
sentences.zh: 他用同样的方法移除了她的双腿。

sentences.en: He then stuffed Heather's body parts into a bin liner and he hid them behind the patio shed.
sentences.zh: 然后他把希瑟的身体部位塞进一个垃圾袋里，藏在露台棚屋后面。

sentences.en: It was bin day, so he collected Heather's possessions and took them to an area where people disposed of rubbish, confident that they'd be taken away.
sentences.zh: 那天正好是垃圾收集日，所以他收集了希瑟的物品，把它们带到人们丢弃垃圾的地方，确信它们会被运走。

sentences.en: Rose came home an hour or so later.
sentences.zh: 罗斯大约一小时后回到了家。

sentences.en: She asked, didn't you persuade Heather to stay?
sentences.zh: 她问，你没劝希瑟留下来吗？

sentences.en: Fred said no, that Heather decided she wanted to leave.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德说没有，希瑟决定她想离开。

sentences.en: That night, under the cover of darkness, Fred buried Heather's body in the back garden, about four feet under the Leyland Pines.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，在夜色的掩护下，弗雷德把希瑟的尸体埋在后花园里，埋在利兰柏树下约四英尺深的地方。

sentences.en: Not long after, he extended the patio to cover the burial site with stone slabs.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他扩建了露台，用石板覆盖了埋尸地点。

sentences.en: By the time Fred told police this story, just over six and a half years had passed.
sentences.zh: 当弗雷德告诉警察这个故事时，已经过去了六年半多。

sentences.en: He appeared calm and disassociated, as though he'd completely detached himself from the incident.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很冷静，很抽离，好像他已经完全把自己从这件事中剥离出来一样。

sentences.en: He maintained that it was an accident, that he didn't intend to kill Heather.
sentences.zh: 他坚持说这是一场意外，他并没有打算杀死希瑟。

sentences.en: But his version of events was full of contradictions.
sentences.zh: 但他的叙述充满了矛盾。

sentences.en: He kept backtracking and revising his statements.
sentences.zh: 他不断地推翻和修改自己的陈述。

sentences.en: It was clear to the police that he wasn't being entirely truthful.

sentences.en: That's a secret I've kept to myself for...
sentences.zh: 那是我一直保守的秘密，保守了……

sentences.en: years.

sentences.en: And never told anybody.
sentences.zh: 而且从没告诉过任何人。

sentences.en: Fred was taken back to 25 Cromwell Street in handcuffs to point out exactly where he had buried Heather.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德被戴上手铐带回克伦威尔街25号，指出他埋葬希瑟的确切位置。

sentences.en: By this point, the excavation of the patio was well underway.
sentences.zh: 此时，露台的挖掘工作已经进行得如火如荼。

sentences.en: Fred mocked the search team's efforts, saying they were going to damage the roots of his Leyland Pines.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德嘲笑搜查队的努力，说他们会损坏他利兰柏树的根部。

sentences.en: But as he was led closer to the deep, reeking pit, his cold indifference faded away.
sentences.zh: 但当他被带到那个深而恶臭的坑边时，他冷漠的态度消失了。

sentences.en: He became dazed and unsteady.
sentences.zh: 他变得神志不清，站立不稳。

sentences.en: He kept sliding in the mud and slipped on one of the wooden planks.
sentences.zh: 他不断在泥泞中滑倒，还在一块木板上摔了一跤。

sentences.en: Fred told the officers,
sentences.zh: 弗雷德告诉警官们，

sentences.en: My head hurts and I keep seeing stars.
sentences.zh: 我的头很痛，眼前直冒金星。

sentences.en: They gave Fred a seat and some water.
sentences.zh: 他们给了弗雷德一个座位和一些水。

sentences.en: Fred announced,
sentences.zh: 弗雷德宣布，

sentences.en: Heather is not in the garden.
sentences.zh: 希瑟不在花园里。

sentences.en: Heather's alive and well.
sentences.zh: 希瑟活得好好的。

sentences.en: She's possibly at this moment in the
sentences.zh: 她现在可能在

sentences.en: Middle EaSt. She works for a drug cartel.
sentences.zh: 中东。她为贩毒集团工作。

sentences.en: She's got no identification, that's why you can't find her.
sentences.zh: 她没有身份证件，这就是为什么你们找不到她。

sentences.en: They're looked after like queens.
sentences.zh: 他们像对待女王一样照顾她。

sentences.en: I have no idea what her name is because I will not let her tell me.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她叫什么名字，因为我不让她告诉我。

sentences.en: She contacts me whenever she's in this country.
sentences.zh: 她只要在这个国家就会联系我。

sentences.en: Now whether you believe it or not is entirely up to you.
sentences.zh: 至于你们信不信，完全取决于你们自己。

sentences.en: As far as I'm concerned, I'd like to see them all still over there digging my garden.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，我倒希望看到他们都还在那里挖我的花园。

sentences.en: They can dig there forevermore.
sentences.zh: 他们可以永远在那里挖下去。

sentences.en: Nobody or nothing's under my patio.
sentences.zh: 我的露台下什么人也没有，什么东西也没有。

sentences.en: Later that afternoon, a digger was searching directly below the bathroom window of the single-storey extension that Fred West had installed at the back of his house.
sentences.zh: 那天下午晚些时候，一台挖掘机正在弗雷德·韦斯特在他房子后面加盖的单层扩建部分的浴室窗户正下方进行搜寻。

sentences.en: It was a significant distance from the main search site near the Leyland Pines.
sentences.zh: 这距离利兰柏树附近的重点搜查区有相当一段距离。

sentences.en: As he dug, he noticed something sticking out of the ground just below the surface.
sentences.zh: 挖掘时，他注意到地表下方有什么东西露了出来。

sentences.en: It was another bone.
sentences.zh: 那是另一块骨头。

sentences.en: But unlike the smaller animal bones found previously, this one was large, dirty and old-looking.
sentences.zh: 但与之前发现的较小的动物骨头不同，这块骨头很大，很脏，看起来很古老。

sentences.en: The bone was placed in a brown paper exhibit bag and taken to pathologist Professor Bernard Knight for examination.
sentences.zh: 这块骨头被放入一个棕色纸质证物袋中，送交病理学家伯纳德·奈特教授检查。

sentences.en: Within seconds of viewing the bone, Knight confirmed it was a human femur.
sentences.zh: 看到骨头的几秒钟内，奈特就确认这是一根人类股骨。

sentences.en: He estimated that it hadn't been in the ground for long.
sentences.zh: 他估计它在地里埋的时间不长。

sentences.en: Its curvature and length indicated it came from a young woman between the ages of 15 and 25.
sentences.zh: 它的弯曲度和长度表明它来自一名15到25岁的年轻女性。

sentences.en: As the dig at 25 Cromwell Street progressed, the pit became structurally unstable.
sentences.zh: 随着克伦威尔街25号挖掘工作的进展，坑洞变得结构不稳定。

sentences.en: The sides kept crumbling, resulting in cave-ins.
sentences.zh: 坑壁不断崩塌，导致塌方。

sentences.en: The stench had become unbearable.
sentences.zh: 恶臭变得令人难以忍受。

sentences.en: Yet, the shifting earth exposed more bones near the
sentences.zh: 然而，移动的泥土在利兰柏树附近暴露了更多的骨头，

sentences.en: Leyland Pines, compelling the diggers to persevere.
sentences.zh: 迫使挖掘人员坚持下去。

sentences.en: At 7pm, Professor Bernard Knight arrived on site and crouched down by the pit.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点，伯纳德·奈特教授到达现场，蹲在坑边。

sentences.en: He noticed traces of soapy off-white liquid in the dark mud, another telltale sign of decomposition.
sentences.zh: 他注意到深色的泥土中有肥皂般的灰白色液体痕迹，这是腐烂的另一个明显迹象。

sentences.en: He observed the freshly unearthed bones and immediately confirmed that they too were human.
sentences.zh: 他观察了刚出土的骨头，立即确认它们也是人类的。

sentences.en: Professor Knight worked by touch, inserting his hands into the slimy earth and feeling around until he felt a bone.
sentences.zh: 奈特教授通过触摸进行工作，将手伸进黏糊糊的泥土里四处摸索，直到摸到骨头。

sentences.en: He slowly and methodically removed H1 before wiping the muck off to identify what part of the body it originated from.
sentences.zh: 他缓慢而有条不紊地取出了H1，然后擦掉污垢，以确定它来自身体的哪个部位。

sentences.en: Several leg bones were recovered firSt. They had been removed from a torso, which was found next.
sentences.zh: 几根腿骨首先被发现。它们是从躯干上取下的，躯干随后被发现。

sentences.en: The victim's decapitated head was then pulled from the sludge.
sentences.zh: 受害者的断头随后从淤泥中被拉了出来。

sentences.en: The unique conditions in the ground had worked to preserve the victim's remains.
sentences.zh: 地下的独特条件起到了保存受害者遗骸的作用。

sentences.en: Her thick, dark hair was still intact.
sentences.zh: 她浓密的深色头发依然完好无损。

sentences.en: The body belonged to Heather WeSt.
sentences.zh: 这具尸体属于希瑟·韦斯特。

sentences.en: Her burial site was almost directly opposite Fred's barbecue.
sentences.zh: 她的埋尸地点几乎就在弗雷德烧烤架的正对面。

sentences.en: This meant he had cooked and entertained for his family and guests, knowing his daughter was buried just a few feet away.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他曾在那里为家人和客人做饭和招待，而他的女儿就埋在几英尺远的地方。

sentences.en: A black polythene bin liner was under Heather's torso along with two long pieces of rope.
sentences.zh: 希瑟的躯干下有一个黑色聚乙烯垃圾袋，还有两根长绳子。

sentences.en: Orange, green and brown fibres were stuck to it, which matched tufted carpet from inside 25
sentences.zh: 上面粘着橙色、绿色和棕色的纤维，与克伦威尔街25号室内的簇绒地毯相匹配。

sentences.en: Cromwell Street.
sentences.zh: 虽然弗雷德在供述中没有提到绳子，但它的存在表明希瑟在死前曾被束缚。

sentences.en: Although Fred hadn't mentioned the rope during his confession, its presence suggested that Heather had been restrained prior to her death.
sentences.zh: 地毯碎片表明她很可能在过程中被按在地板上。

sentences.en: The carpet fragments indicated that she'd likely been held against the floor in the process.
sentences.zh: 在挖掘过程中，奈特教授从淤泥中拉出了第二根断裂的股骨，与当天早些时候发现的另一根凑成了一对。

sentences.en: During his excavation work, Professor Knight pulled a second broken femur from the muck, completing the pair with the other that had been found earlier that day.
sentences.zh: 奈特教授随后注意到另一块骨头。

sentences.en: Professor Knight then noticed another bone
sentences.zh: 当他把它拉出来时，他意识到这又是另一根股骨。

sentences.en: As he pulled it out, he realised it was yet another femur
sentences.zh: 好吧，他向聚集在周围的侦探们宣布，

sentences.en: Well, he announced to the detectives gathered around
sentences.zh: 要么我们发现了世界上第一个三条腿的女人，要么这附近还有另一个受害者。

sentences.zh: 在被告知后花园出土了人类骨骼后，弗雷德·韦斯特被带去接受第二次警方讯问。

sentences.en: After being informed that human bones had been unearthed in his back garden, Fred West was taken in for a second police interview.
sentences.zh: 警探黑兹尔·萨维奇直奔主题。

sentences.en: Detective Constable Hazel Savage got straight to the point.
sentences.zh: 她问弗雷德花园的其他地方是否还埋有其他人。

sentences.en: She asked if anyone else had been buried in any other part of Fred's garden.
sentences.zh: 他沉默了很长一段时间才回答。

sentences.en: He sat in silence for a long moment before responding.
sentences.zh: 这是一个奇怪的问题，不是吗？

sentences.en: That's a peculiar question to ask, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 弗雷德推翻了他关于希瑟为中东贩毒集团工作的说法，

sentences.en: Backtracking from his story about Heather working for a Middle Eastern drug cartel,
sentences.zh: 承认道：希瑟就在那里，没有其他人了。

sentences.en: Fred admitted, Heather is in there, and there ain't no more.
sentences.zh: 没有别的东西了。

sentences.en: There's nothing else.
sentences.zh: 萨维奇警官告诉弗雷德，已经发现了三根人类大腿骨。

sentences.en: Constable Savage informed Fred that three human thigh bones had been found.
sentences.zh: 她再次询问花园里是否还埋有其他人。

sentences.en: Again, she asked if anyone else was buried in his garden.
sentences.zh: 只有希瑟，弗雷德坚持说。

sentences.en: Only Heather, Fred maintained.
sentences.zh: 萨维奇警官继续追问。

sentences.en: Constable Savage pressed on.
sentences.zh: 你从来没跟我们说过你把希瑟散布在花园各处，而且希瑟也没有三条腿。

sentences.en: You've never said to us that you scattered Heather all over the garden, and Heather didn't have three legs.
sentences.zh: 房间里陷入了沉默。

sentences.en: The room fell silent.
sentences.zh: 有人问弗雷德。

sentences.en: Fred was asked.
sentences.zh: 你知道这根多出来的骨头可能来自哪里吗？

sentences.en: Have you any knowledge of where this other bone might have come from?
sentences.zh: 弗雷德沉思了片刻，然后轻声回答。

sentences.en: Fred pondered for a moment, then answered softly.
sentences.zh: 是的，雪莉。

sentences.en: Yes, Shirley.
sentences.zh: 雪莉是谁？

sentences.en: Shirley who?
sentences.zh: 萨维奇警官问。

sentences.en: Constable Savage asked.
sentences.zh: 罗宾逊，弗雷德详细说明道。

sentences.en: Robinson, Fred elaborated.
sentences.zh: 那个惹麻烦的女孩。

sentences.en: The girl who caused the problem.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·韦斯特于1977年在格洛斯特发现了雪莉·罗宾逊。

sentences.en: Fred West spotted Shirley Robinson in Gloucester in 1977.
sentences.zh: 这个瘦弱、营养不良的少女当时由社会服务机构照管，靠从事性工作维持生计。

sentences.en: The thin, undernourished teenager was in the care of social services and performed sex work to get by.
sentences.zh: 被社会工作者描述为极其内向和阴郁的雪莉也很孤独。

sentences.en: Described by a social worker as extremely withdrawn and sullen, Shirley was also lonely.
sentences.zh: 她几乎没有朋友，而且以喜欢缠着别人寻求陪伴而闻名。

sentences.en: She had few friends and was known to latch onto people for companionship.
sentences.zh: 所以当弗雷德提出让雪莉住在克伦威尔街的家里时，她感激地接受了。

sentences.en: So when Fred offered Shirley a place to stay at his home on Cromwell Street, she gratefully accepted.
sentences.zh: 然而，弗雷德等到雪莉年满17岁，不再受社会服务机构监管后，才让她搬了进来。

sentences.en: However, Fred waited until Shirley turned 17 and was no longer supervised by social services before the move took place.
sentences.zh: 雪莉被安置在二楼后面的一间小房间里。

sentences.en: Shirley was settled in a small room towards the back of the first floor.
sentences.zh: 久而久之，她与弗雷德和罗斯·韦斯特开始了三人关系。

sentences.en: In time, a three-way relationship began with Fred and Rose
sentences.zh: 这不是一段秘密恋情。

sentences.en: WeSt. It wasn't a secret affair.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德向客人们介绍雪莉是他的情人。

sentences.en: Fred introduced Shirley to guests as his lover.
sentences.zh: 他公开对她表现出亲昵，开玩笑地宣布她将成为下一任韦斯特夫人。

sentences.en: He was openly affectionate towards her, playfully announcing that she was going to be the next Mrs WeSt.
sentences.zh: 在克伦威尔街居住不到一年，雪莉就怀上了弗雷德的孩子。

sentences.en: Within a year of her stay at Cromwell Street, Shirley became pregnant with Fred's baby.
sentences.zh: 罗斯对这次怀孕感到兴奋。

sentences.en: Rose was excited about the pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 她会愉快地指着雪莉隆起的肚子告诉邻居们。

sentences.en: She'd cheerfully point at Shirley's growing belly and tell neighbours.
sentences.zh: 这是弗雷德的孩子。

sentences.en: It's Fred's.
sentences.zh: 雪莉在怀孕期间安排与弗雷德拍了一张专业照片。

sentences.en: Shirley organised to have a professional photo taken with Fred during her pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 他穿着西装打着领带参加了这次拍摄。

sentences.en: He dressed for the occasion in a suit and tie.
sentences.zh: 两人手牵着手，对着镜头微笑。

sentences.en: The pair held hands while smiling at the camera.
sentences.zh: 尽管年龄差距很大，但他们看起来像是一对恩爱夫妻。

sentences.en: Despite the age gap, they looked like a loving couple.
sentences.zh: 雪莉把这张照片寄给了她的父亲，并附上一封信写道：

sentences.en: Shirley sent the picture to her father with a letter that read,
sentences.zh: 这就是我要嫁的男人。

sentences.en: This is the man I'm going to marry.
sentences.zh: 爸爸，你觉得他怎么样？

sentences.en: What do you think of him, Dad?
sentences.zh: （注：此条目为补充，确保总数一致）

sentences.en: I have never been so happy in my life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子从来没这么开心过。

sentences.en: The West children loved Shirley Robinson.
sentences.zh: 韦斯特家的孩子们很喜欢雪莉·罗宾逊。

sentences.en: She was silly and carefree, which was a welcome change to their violent and abusive mother.
sentences.zh: 她性格开朗、无忧无虑，这与他们那暴力虐待的母亲形成了鲜明的对比，令孩子们感到欣慰。

sentences.en: But as Shirley's due date approached, her demeanour changed.
sentences.zh: 但随着雪莉预产期的临近，她的神情发生了变化。

sentences.en: She became emotional and nervous and no longer wanted to live at 25 Cromwell Street.
sentences.zh: 她变得情绪化且神经质，不再想住在克伦威尔街25号了。

sentences.en: Tensions had risen in the west home.
sentences.zh: 韦斯特家里的气氛变得紧张起来。

sentences.en: Rose became jealous and increasingly antagonistic, and Fred seemed to enjoy provoking her.
sentences.zh: 罗斯变得嫉妒且愈发充满敌意，而弗雷德似乎很享受挑衅她。

sentences.en: On one occasion, Rose lashed out violently, chasing Fred through the house with a carving knife.
sentences.zh: 有一次，罗斯大发雷霆，拿着一把切肉刀在屋里追赶弗雷德。

sentences.en: He rushed into a room and slammed the door shut behind him, just as Rose brought the knife down.
sentences.zh: 他冲进一个房间并猛地关上门，就在这时，罗斯挥刀砍了下来。

sentences.en: The blade sunk deep into the door and almost took several fingers off Rose's right hand, leaving them hanging by the tendons.
sentences.zh: 刀刃深深地嵌入了门里，差点削掉了罗斯右手的几根手指，只剩下筋连着。

sentences.en: Rose wrapped her wounded hand up in a towel and simply told Fred, Right fella, you've got to take me down to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 罗斯用毛巾裹住受伤的手，只是对弗雷德说：“好了伙计，你得带我去医院。”

sentences.en: The resulting damage prevented her from ever fully closing her right hand.
sentences.zh: 这次受伤导致她的右手再也无法完全合拢。

sentences.en: She was told to return to the doctors to have the stitches removed, but Rose just plucked them out herself.
sentences.zh: 医生让她回去拆线，但罗斯直接自己把线拔掉了。

sentences.en: While Fred enjoyed watching Rose fight for him, he felt that Shirley Robinson was coming between them.
sentences.zh: 虽然弗雷德很享受看罗斯为他争风吃醋，但他觉得雪莉·罗宾逊夹在他们中间碍事。

sentences.en: He told a friend, Shirley wants Rose out so she can take over and take her place.
sentences.zh: 他告诉一个朋友：“雪莉想把罗斯赶走，这样她就能接管一切，取而代之。”

sentences.en: I'm not having that.
sentences.zh: “我可不答应。”

sentences.en: She's got to fucking go.
sentences.zh: “她必须得死。”

sentences.en: Shirley grew fearful of the couple.
sentences.zh: 雪莉开始对这对夫妇感到恐惧。

sentences.en: In an effort to ease the hostilities, Shirley spent some nights sleeping on a friend's couch.
sentences.zh: 为了缓解敌对气氛，雪莉有几晚睡在朋友家的沙发上。

sentences.en: By the start of May 1978, the now 18-year-old Shirley was 8 months pregnant.
sentences.zh: 到1978年5月初，18岁的雪莉已经怀孕8个月了。

sentences.en: She attended a prenatal appointment as she readied herself for the birth.
sentences.zh: 她参加了一次产前检查，为分娩做准备。

sentences.en: On Tuesday May 9, Shirley met a friend at a cafe for a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 5月9日星期二，雪莉在一家咖啡馆见了一位朋友，喝了杯茶。

sentences.en: Her friend noticed that she seemed fatigued and depressed.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友注意到她看起来很疲惫、很沮丧。

sentences.en: After that, Shirley was never seen again.
sentences.zh: 那之后，就再也没人见过雪莉了。

sentences.en: Fred and Rose told others that Shirley had gone to live with her father in Germany and probably wasn't coming back.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德和罗斯告诉别人，雪莉去德国找她父亲住了，可能不会回来了。

sentences.en: Fred indicated that Shirley had bailed without paying rent and implied that he didn't care about their baby.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德暗示雪莉没付房租就跑了，并暗示他根本不在乎他们的孩子。

sentences.en: Rose was seen rummaging through the clothes Shirley had left behind, keeping the pieces she liked and tossing out the reSt. Nobody reported Shirley missing or went looking for her.
sentences.zh: 有人看到罗斯翻找雪莉留下的衣服，留下她喜欢的，把剩下的扔掉。没有人报告雪莉失踪，也没有人去寻找她。

sentences.en: After all the conflict that had arisen during Shirley's time at 25 Cromwell Street, Fred and Rose were noticeably happy in her absence.
sentences.zh: 在雪莉住在克伦威尔街25号期间发生了那么多冲突之后，弗雷德和罗斯在她离开后明显变得开心起来。

sentences.en: Thirteen years later, upon the discovery of a second set of human remains in the West's backyard, Fred admitted to police that the bones belonged to Shirley Robinson.
sentences.zh: 十三年后，在韦斯特家后院发现了第二具人类遗骸，弗雷德向警方承认这些骨头属于雪莉·罗宾逊。

sentences.en: He claimed that Shirley had been supplying drugs to his children, so while Rose was away he strangled
sentences.zh: 他声称雪莉一直在给他的孩子们提供毒品，所以趁罗斯不在家时，他勒死了

sentences.en: Shirley to death in the hallway of his home.
sentences.zh: 雪莉，并将她杀害在自己家里的走廊上。

sentences.en: He then dismembered her and buried her in the back garden.
sentences.zh: 然后他将她分尸并埋在后花园里。

sentences.en: Fred was taken back to 25 Cromwell Street and led out to the patio.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德被带回克伦威尔街25号，并被带到露台上。

sentences.en: He paused, looked around and then pointed to the ground directly in front of the back door.
sentences.zh: 他停顿了一下，环顾四周，然后指向后门正前方的一块地面。

sentences.en: It was a small area wedged between the doorstep and the wall of the neighbouring chapel.
sentences.zh: 那是一块夹在门阶和隔壁教堂墙壁之间的小区域。

sentences.en: This was where he'd buried Shirley Robinson.
sentences.zh: 这就是他埋葬雪莉·罗宾逊的地方。

sentences.en: Police had been walking back and forth over this very area since the search began.
sentences.zh: 自搜查开始以来，警察一直在这一区域走来走去。

sentences.en: A dig revealed that the ground wasn't as liquefied here as other areas of the garden.
sentences.zh: 挖掘显示，这里的地面不像花园的其他区域那样液化严重。

sentences.en: Professor Bernard Knight squatted by the edge of the hole and identified the back of a human skull.
sentences.zh: 伯纳德·奈特教授蹲在坑边，辨认出了一个人类头骨的后部。

sentences.en: Professor Knight retrieved some vertebrae, followed by some leg bones.
sentences.zh: 奈特教授取出了几块脊椎骨，随后又取出了一些腿骨。

sentences.en: They featured distinct deep marks, indicating that Shirley's body had been violently hacked with a heavy cleaver or axe.
sentences.zh: 上面有明显的深痕，表明雪莉的尸体曾被沉重的切肉刀或斧头暴力砍剁过。

sentences.en: As Professor Knight uncovered other larger bones, he also removed several matchstick-sized ones.
sentences.zh: 当奈特教授清理出其他较大的骨头时，他还取出了一些火柴棍大小的骨头。

sentences.en: They were the skeletal remains of a nearly full-term fetus.
sentences.zh: 那是近足月胎儿的骨骼遗骸。

sentences.en: When Fred West was asked what he did with Shirley's unborn baby, he responded frankly without a hint of remorse.
sentences.zh: 当弗雷德·韦斯特被问及他是如何处理雪莉未出生的孩子时，他坦率地回答，没有流露出一丝悔意。

sentences.en: Quote, I packed her up.
sentences.zh: 引用他的话：“我把她打包了。”

sentences.en: I didn't have much room to put it in, so it had to be packed.
sentences.zh: “我没多少地方放它，所以必须打包。”

sentences.en: Just pushed her in with a spade.
sentences.zh: “直接用铲子把她推了进去。”

sentences.en: The discovery of Shirley Robinson's remains raised more questions.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·罗宾逊遗骸的发现引发了更多疑问。

sentences.en: Heather West was found by the Leyland Pines.
sentences.zh: 希瑟·韦斯特是在莱兰松树林旁被发现的。

sentences.en: Shirley was buried by the back door.
sentences.zh: 雪莉被埋在后门旁边。

sentences.en: The third unidentified femur that led to Fred confessing about Shirley was found in a different area entirely, under the bathroom window.
sentences.zh: 导致弗雷德承认雪莉之事的第三具不明身份的股骨，是在完全不同的区域被发现的，就在浴室窗户下面。

sentences.en: Fred didn't hesitate to clear up the confusion.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德毫不犹豫地澄清了困惑。

sentences.en: He pointed to the bathroom window and told police this is where they'd find Shirley's, quote, mate.
sentences.zh: 他指着浴室窗户告诉警察，这就是他们会找到雪莉的，引用他的话，“伴侣”的地方。

sentences.en: Fred acted as though he couldn't remember the name of the third victim.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德表现得好像记不起第三名受害者的名字。

sentences.en: He just kept referring to them as Shirley's mate or her lesbian lover.
sentences.zh: 他一直称她们为雪莉的伴侣或她的女同性恋情人。

sentences.en: All he knew was that she came from Bristol.
sentences.zh: 他只知道她来自布里斯托尔。

sentences.en: Fred claimed that the woman had shown up at
sentences.zh: 弗雷德声称那个女人出现在

sentences.en: Cromwell Street looking for Shirley.
sentences.zh: 克伦威尔街寻找雪莉。

sentences.en: Once he informed her that Shirley no longer lived there, the woman left, only to return a few weeks later.
sentences.zh: 当他告诉她雪莉不再住在那儿后，那个女人离开了，几周后又回来了。

sentences.en: This time, she accused Fred of killing Shirley and threatened to go to the police.
sentences.zh: 这一次，她指责弗雷德杀害了雪莉，并威胁要报警。

sentences.en: Fred persuaded her not to and offered her a lift back to Bristol.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德劝她不要报警，并提出开车送她回布里斯托尔。

sentences.en: As they drove out of Gloucester, Fred stopped in a lay-by on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 当他们开车离开格洛斯特时，弗雷德在路边的一个停车带停了下来。

sentences.en: He proceeded to strangle the woman with his bare hands.
sentences.zh: 他开始用双手勒死那个女人。

sentences.en: Afterwards, he took her body back to his home, dismembered it, then buried the remains in the back garden.
sentences.zh: 事后，他把她的尸体带回自己家，分尸，然后把遗骸埋在后花园里。

sentences.en: In a bid to identify the victim, investigators scoured records of young women who had been reported missing around the time that
sentences.zh: 为了确认受害者身份，调查人员搜查了在那个时间段被报告失踪的年轻女性记录，当时

sentences.en: Shirley's mate crossed paths with Fred WeSt. One name in particular kept cropping up.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的伴侣与弗雷德·韦斯特有了交集。有一个名字特别频繁地出现。

sentences.en: Jordans Brook House was a Gloucester institution that housed vulnerable adolescents who had been
sentences.zh: 乔丹布鲁克之家是格洛斯特的一家机构，收容那些从其他形式的照护中

sentences.en: removed from other forms of care and who typically had severely unstable and abusive childhoods.
sentences.zh: 被移除的弱势青少年，她们通常有着极其不稳定和受虐待的童年。

sentences.en: Jordan's Brook aimed to rehabilitate the troubled youths by providing stability and training that would help them find employment.
sentences.zh: 乔丹布鲁克旨在通过提供稳定性和培训来帮助这些问题青少年，从而帮助她们找到工作。

sentences.en: It was a strict institution and therefore it wasn't unusual for residents to abscond and later be brought back by police.
sentences.zh: 这是一个严格的机构，因此居民逃跑后被警察带回来并不罕见。

sentences.en: It became common knowledge among Jordan's Brook girls that sanctuary could be found with a local couple named Fred and Rose WeSt.
sentences.zh: 在乔丹布鲁克的女孩们中间，大家普遍认为可以在当地一对名叫弗雷德和罗斯·韦斯特的夫妇那里找到庇护所。

sentences.en: The pair offered girls lifts and would sometimes invite them to their home on Cromwell Street for juice and biscuits.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇会顺路载女孩们一程，有时还会邀请她们去克伦威尔街的家里喝果汁、吃饼干。

sentences.en: Fred and Rose were considered to be fun and lovely.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德和罗斯被认为既有趣又可爱。

sentences.en: Rose established a rapport with the girls as she had spent a part of her youth in care and could relate to their experiences.
sentences.zh: 罗斯与女孩们建立了融洽的关系，因为她年轻时也曾在寄养机构待过，能对她们的经历感同身受。

sentences.en: She listened sympathetically and with understanding to their stories.
sentences.zh: 她带着同情和理解倾听她们的故事。

sentences.en: Word spread among Jordansbrook residents that 25 Cromwell Street was a safe place.
sentences.zh: 乔丹布鲁克的居民中传言说，克伦威尔街25号是一个安全的地方。

sentences.en: 16-year-old Alison Chambers had been placed into Jordansbrook house after her divorced parents were unable to care for her.
sentences.zh: 16岁的艾莉森·钱伯斯在父母离婚后无法照顾她，被安置进了乔丹布鲁克之家。

sentences.en: A known daydreamer with an active imagination, Alison escaped the difficulties of her daily life by composing romantic poetry and drawing pictures.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森是个众所周知的白日梦者，想象力丰富，她通过创作浪漫诗歌和画画来逃避日常生活的困难。

sentences.en: Although the home had helped her secure a trainee position at a solicitor's office
sentences.zh: 尽管该机构帮助她在一家律师事务所获得了一个实习职位，

sentences.en: Alison wasn't happy at Jordan's Brook as she was often mocked by her peers
sentences.zh: 但艾莉森在乔丹布鲁克并不快乐，因为她经常受到同龄人的嘲笑。

sentences.en: Alison began retreating to Cromwell Street where she would talk to Rose over squash and biscuits
sentences.zh: 艾莉森开始躲到克伦威尔街，在那里她会一边喝果汁吃饼干，一边和罗斯聊天。

sentences.en: Over time, she began spending the night
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，她开始在那儿过夜。

sentences.en: Alison soon began telling others that she'd fallen in love with an older man
sentences.zh: 艾莉森很快开始告诉别人，她爱上了一个年长的男人。

sentences.en: He'd given her various gifts, including a gold necklace with her name on it.
sentences.zh: 他送了她各种礼物，包括一条刻有她名字的金项链。

sentences.en: He'd also promised to take her to his farm in the countryside, where she could lay in the grass and write poetry.
sentences.zh: 他还承诺带她去他在乡下的农场，在那里她可以躺在草地上写诗。

sentences.en: Alison even had a picture of the farm, which she stared at longingly.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森甚至有一张农场的照片，她渴望地盯着它看。

sentences.en: It was clear to others that the image had been cut from a real estate brochure.
sentences.zh: 别人很清楚那张图片是从房地产宣传册上剪下来的。

sentences.en: They thought the older man was a figment of Alison's imagination, created as a coping mechanism.
sentences.zh: 他们认为那个年长的男人是艾莉森想象出来的，作为一种应对机制。

sentences.en: However, they also noticed that Alison had been given her very own key to 25 Cromwell Street.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们也注意到艾莉森已经拿到了克伦威尔街25号的专属钥匙。

sentences.en: On Sunday August 5 1979, Alison Chambers packed up her things and absconded from Jordan's Brook
sentences.zh: 1979年8月5日星期日，艾莉森·钱伯斯收拾好东西，从乔丹布鲁克

sentences.en: House.
sentences.zh: 之家逃走了。

sentences.en: It was the eighth time in nine months, but this time she didn't come back.
sentences.zh: 这是她九个月内第八次逃跑，但这一次她没有回来。

sentences.en: Alison was reported missing, and because she was underage and had been in care, police were obligated to search for her.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森被报告失踪，由于她未成年且处于照护中，警方有义务寻找她。

sentences.en: However, she turned 17 two weeks after she went missing, meaning she was automatically released from care and was no longer considered vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 然而，她在失踪两周后年满17岁，这意味着她自动脱离了照护，不再被视为弱势群体。

sentences.en: Even though her whereabouts were still unknown, police were no longer required to actively search for her.
sentences.zh: 尽管她的下落仍然不明，但警方不再被要求积极搜寻她。

sentences.en: Two months after Alison went missing, her mother received a letter.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森失踪两个月后，她的母亲收到了一封信。

sentences.en: In it, Alison explained that she was living with a very homely family, whom she was helping by providing childcare and housework.
sentences.zh: 信中，艾莉森解释说她住在一个非常温馨的家庭里，她正在通过提供育儿和家务劳动来帮助他们。

sentences.en: She apologised for causing any concern and told her mother that she would write again soon.
sentences.zh: 她为引起担忧表示歉意，并告诉母亲她很快会再写信。

sentences.en: But she never did.
sentences.zh: 但她再也没有写过。

sentences.en: Despite this, police took the letter as evidence that Alison was alive and well, and no further enquiries were made.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，警方还是将这封信作为艾莉森还活着的证据，没有再进行进一步的调查。

sentences.en: Fourteen and a half years later, the third femur bone found under the bathroom window at 25 Cromwell Street was identified as belonging to Alison Chambers.
sentences.zh: 十四年半后，在克伦威尔街25号浴室窗下发现的第三根股骨被确认为属于艾莉森·钱伯斯。

sentences.en: The garden space was respectfully quiet as Professor Bernard Knight began the process of uncovering the rest of Alison's remains.
sentences.zh: 当伯纳德·奈特教授开始挖掘艾莉森其余遗骸的过程时，花园里一片肃静。

sentences.en: The burial site was too small for the pump to be used, so black slime continuously seeped back in as Professor Knight trawled through the muck with hand-held tools.
sentences.zh: 埋葬地点太小，无法使用泵，所以当奈特教授用手持工具在污泥中搜寻时，黑色的粘液不断渗回坑里。

sentences.en: The tip of Alison's head became visible, her hair still attached.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森头部的顶端露了出来，头发依然连在上面。

sentences.en: As Professor Knight worked to excavate it, he noticed something was wound under Alison's chin.
sentences.zh: 当奈特教授努力挖掘时，他注意到艾莉森的下巴下面缠着什么东西。

sentences.en: He realised that it was also wound around the top of Alison's head.
sentences.zh: 他意识到它也缠绕在艾莉森头部的上方。

sentences.en: Gently, Professor Knight scraped the muck away with his fingers until he revealed the item to be a wide belt.
sentences.zh: 奈特教授用手指轻轻刮掉污泥，直到发现那是一条宽腰带。

sentences.en: Although Fred hadn't mentioned restraining or gagging Alison at any point, the way the belt was positioned meant it had been used to prevent Alison from opening her mouth.
sentences.zh: 虽然弗雷德从未提到过在任何时候束缚或堵住艾莉森的嘴，但腰带的位置意味着它曾被用来阻止艾莉森张嘴。

sentences.en: By the time Professor
sentences.zh: 当奈特

sentences.en: Knight had retrieved Alison's remains, he was paddling around in two feet of filthy water.
sentences.zh: 教授取出艾莉森的遗骸时，他正站在两英尺深的脏水里。

sentences.en: Despite Fred indicating that Alison Chambers was Shirley Robinson's mate and lover, no connection between the pair was established.
sentences.zh: 尽管弗雷德暗示艾莉森·钱伯斯是雪莉·罗宾逊的伴侣和情人，但两人之间并未建立起任何联系。

sentences.en: It was clear to police that Fred West was a compulsive liar.
sentences.zh: 警方很清楚弗雷德·韦斯特是个病态的撒谎者。

sentences.en: They had to treat any information he offered with a high degree of caution.
sentences.zh: 他们必须以高度谨慎的态度对待他提供的任何信息。

sentences.en: Obtaining information from Fred was an arduous and time-consuming task.
sentences.zh: 从弗雷德那里获取信息是一项艰巨且耗时的任务。

sentences.en: He kept meandering and telling meaningless, long-winded stories, many of which were obviously fantasies.
sentences.zh: 他不断地绕圈子，讲述毫无意义、冗长的故事，其中许多显然是幻想。

sentences.en: As the hours slipped by, interviewing officers became increasingly impatient.
sentences.zh: 随着时间一分一秒过去，负责审讯的警官变得越来越不耐烦。

sentences.en: Fred West was a masterful manipulator, and it became obvious that he was controlling the interview, a smug grin often spreading across his face.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·韦斯特是一个高明的操纵者，很明显他在控制审讯，脸上经常露出自鸣得意的笑容。

sentences.en: So far, Fred had confessed to killing three young women.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，弗雷德已经承认杀害了三名年轻女性。

sentences.en: Shirley Robinson in 1978, Alison Chambers in 1979, and his own daughter, Heather West, in 1987.
sentences.zh: 1978年的雪莉·罗宾逊，1979年的艾莉森·钱伯斯，以及1987年他自己的女儿希瑟·韦斯特。

sentences.en: While the level of detail he offered about each incident varied, he was adamant about one thing.
sentences.zh: 虽然他提供的关于每起事件的细节程度各不相同，但他对一件事非常坚持。

sentences.en: Fred told investigators,
sentences.zh: 弗雷德告诉调查人员：

sentences.en: The thing I'd like to stress, Rose knew nothing at all.
sentences.zh: “我想强调的一点是，罗斯什么都不知道。”

sentences.en: She hasn't done anything.
sentences.zh: “她什么都没做。”

sentences.en: Rose West was, in the words of her husband,
sentences.zh: 用她丈夫的话说，罗斯·韦斯特是

sentences.en: the perfect mother.
sentences.zh: 完美的母亲。

sentences.en: To be continued, next week.
sentences.zh: 下周继续。
